subject: Veridian Health — expansion forecast & CS handoff
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@veridianhealth.com>, Jason Liu <jason.liu@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Veridian Health — expansion forecast & CS handoff

Hi Samantha / Jason —

Quick note to align on the expansion we scoped in July. Finance is closing the month and I want to make sure the forecast reflects the current ask from Veridian. Can you confirm the expected start month and the committed line items below? If helpful, Monica from CS is looped in to confirm the rollout cadence.

Current proposal (from MOP v2):
- +100k tokens/month committed for 12 months
- Dedicated throughput (2x gpus) for initial 90 days, then autoscale to shared
- Professional services: onboarding week + two training sessions

Ask: please confirm
1) Whether you will sign the MOP as-is or need a redline
2) Target billing start month (Aug/Sept/Oct)
3) Any procurement blockers we should know about

Attach: Veridian_MOP_v2.pdf (attachment: Veridian_MOP_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB))

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Cho <samantha@veridianhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jason Liu <jason.liu@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian Health — expansion forecast & CS handoff

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the summary. We reviewed the MOP and have two questions before we can commit:
- Can you confirm whether the 2x GPU dedicated window is guaranteed SLA or a best-effort reservation? Our compliance team wants clarity for the first 90 days.
- For billing start, we are targeting the week of Sept 6 (post change freeze) — can Redwood align to a Sept invoice instead of Aug?

Procurement: our legal team needs the SOW attached to the order form. If you can push the MOP and order form to DocuSign that would speed things up.

Appreciate it,
Samantha Cho
Director, Digital Ops — Veridian Health

>

Hi Samantha —

Short answers: dedicated capacity in Redwood Dedicated for the 90-day onboarding is a reserved pool and comes with an SLA (included in the Dedicated contract addendum). I will attach the SLA excerpt to this thread. We can absolutely align billing to start Sept 6 — just confirm the signed order date and we will mark the invoice accordingly.

Implementation notes for Jason/Rachel: our onboarding plan assumes two full-day training sessions in week 2 and a follow-up health check at day 45. We'll need API access and a named admin list for provision.

(attachment: usage_report_2026Q2.csv (CSV, 45KB))

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Veridian Health — expansion forecast & CS handoff

Folks —

Finance is prepping the August forecast and asked me to confirm the committed amount we should mark for Veridian. Current deal lines show: 12-month commitment at +$100k/month ARR in product usage and $30k PS (one-time). If we move billing to Sept, we need to reflect a partial-month effective date in Aug estimates (zero invoice for Aug, start Sept). Please confirm whether Rachel expects a signed DocuSign before 8/20 — if not, we should mark the opportunity as "Commit - at risk" for August forecast and move to "Committed" in September once signed.

Quick options:
- Signed by 8/20 -> include full value in Aug rolling forecast (billing start Sept)
- Not signed by 8/20 -> mark as "Commit - at risk" for Aug and escalate for exec approval if needed

Rachel — can you confirm expected sign date?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
